people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
translations.bsb: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
translations.kjv: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
translations.asv: My brethren, hold not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
